why: Project rule (step 15 round 3): a call on an object a lower-case callee made under a built-in's name (`disp(g)` after `g = gadget();`) keeps its row, dormant, while a class of the callee's name exists in any package and any case, or while a plain call of the built-in's name would be kept (a project `disp.m` a bare call reaches somewhere, here one in another folder's `private/`, out of the caller's reach); else it is dropped. `+pkg/gadget.m` is such a class (MATLAB's own `disp` runs: `gadget()` reaches the root function, no class); `lib/GADGET.m` is one in another case, which `gaDGet()` names too. The steps take the class away, bring another case's, take it away and bring the private `disp.m`, then take that away; each must end where a fresh index ends.
